descriptionChirho: The Mesopotamian prophet/diviner Balaam son of Beor, hired by Balak king of Moab to curse Israel but compelled by God to bless them instead (Numbers 22-24). All occurrences — nominative, with prepositions (to/for Balaam), and with conjunctions — refer to a single individual. Multilingual evidence is unanimous: eng 'Balaam', spa 'Balaam', hin 'बिलआम', arb 'بِلْعَام', kor '발람', swa 'Balaamu'.
